name: US Sonic Dollar
oneLiner: USSD is Sonic Labs's permissionless 1:1 dollar built on Frax's frxUSD infrastructure, backed by tokenized U.S. Treasury products and approved stablecoins.
collateral: Short-duration tokenized U.S. Treasury products held by approved custodians: BlackRock BUIDL (USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund), Superstate USTB (Short Duration U.S. Government Securities Fund), and WisdomTree WTGXX (Government Money Market Digital Fund); supported minting collateral also includes USDC, USDT, PYUSD, and USDB
pegMechanism: 1:1 permissionless mint and redemption via non-custodial smart contracts built on Frax's frxUSD infrastructure; users mint with any approved USD asset (USDC, USDT, PYUSD, USDB, BUIDL, USTB, WTGXX) at zero fee; redeem into any supported USD asset at any time with no lockup or withdrawal delay; cross-chain via CCTP; yield from Treasury reserves flows to the Sonic ecosystem rather than to USSD holders

applicabilityBasis.summary: Sonic Labs markets USSD as a Treasury-backed, 1:1 mint/redeem dollar built on GENIUS-compatible frxUSD infrastructure; the issuer's public positioning treats it as a payment stablecoin subject to the GENIUS Act.

genius.notes: Sonic Labs publicly markets USSD as 'fully compatible with the GENIUS Act' and has established Sonic USA LLC (Delaware) for U.S. regulatory engagement. No PPSI application, OCC/FDIC/Federal Reserve filing, or state-qualified authorization has been found. The GENIUS Act rulemaking remains in proposed-rules phase with no PPSI approvals granted to any issuer as of 2026-06-18. Foreign exception status updated to not-applicable as the issuer is U.S.-domiciled.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No token-specific PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official GENIUS Act application filing, or comparable foreign-issuer exception was located for USSD or Sonic Labs / Sonic USA LLC in any federal or state regulatory database. Sonic Labs' GENIUS compatibility claims are issuer marketing, not regulatory disclosures.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USSD uses Frax/LayerZero OFT-style omnichain infrastructure for cross-chain USSD minting, while CCTP v2 remains a secondary USDC redemption rail. The durable cross-chain risk is therefore the external LayerZero route plus scoped CCTP redemption exposure, not issuer-native CCTP alone.

mintAuthority.summary: USSD is a Sonic Labs dollar built on Frax's frxUSD infrastructure. The tracked direct mint path is a BrandedCustodian that accepts local frxUSD and calls the USSD token's MINTER_ROLE; external Frax routes expose a broader issuer-administered set of approved USD assets and tokenized Treasury reserves.

controls.label: Sonic BrandedCustodian (USSD direct mint gateway)
controls.capDescription: BrandedCustodian.mintCap() returned uint256.max at Sonic block 75932905. Its public deposit/mint path takes local frxUSD, calls USSD mint(), and enforces the cap after minting; the custodian owner controls setMintCap().
controls.evidence: At Sonic block 75932905, the USSD proxy's MINTER_ROLE holder is 0x54e14489646fd9693ea5071cb5dfeb1f5afa8f03. The verified BrandedCustodian source shows deposit() and mint() transfer in custodianTkn, call brandedStablecoin.mint(), and enforce mintCap; live reads returned brandedStablecoin()=0x000000000eccff26b795f73fb0a70d48da657fef, custodianTkn()=0x80eede496655fb9047dd39d9f418d5483ed600df, mintCap()=uint256.max, and owner()=0x63e89638743a409e2389f06a3f778a4570314d7d.

controls.label: Sonic BrandedFactory (USSD MINTER_ROLE admin and custodian owner)
controls.capDescription: The live BrandedCustodian owner is this BrandedFactory, so it is the on-chain owner authority for setMintCap(). The token's FACTORY_ROLE is also held by this address, and the verified GeniusDollar source sets FACTORY_ROLE as MINTER_ROLE's admin role.
controls.evidence: At Sonic block 75932905, FACTORY_ROLE() returned 0xdfbefbf47cfe66b701d8cfdbce1de81c821590819cb07e71cb01b6602fb0ee27 and its sole RoleGranted account was 0x63e89638743a409e2389f06a3f778a4570314d7d. The same address is owner() of the direct BrandedCustodian. Verified BrandedFactory source grants MINTER_ROLE to each deployed custodian, while verified BrandedCustodian source gates setMintCap() with onlyOwner.

controls.label: USSD Frax ProxyAdmin (mint implementation upgrade)
controls.evidence: At Sonic block 75932905, the USSD proxy's EIP-1967 admin slot returned ProxyAdmin 0x95081db6a3ae3e1d14d66e68c703e463e4faf912. ProxyAdmin.owner() returned 0x87c7a1ef67c67cd57cbf101522a0c3b19d2c3aac; the verified OpenZeppelin ProxyAdmin source exposes upgradeAndCall with no timelock or delay mechanism. The same proxy admin and owner are present on the Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, and Scroll deployments at their current blocks.

review.evidence: At current blocks on Sonic (75932905), Ethereum (25531120), Base (48622804), Arbitrum (483776104), Optimism (154218090), and Scroll (34361168), all six tracked USSD deployments resolve to implementation 0x155384be… and ProxyAdmin 0x95081db6…. On Sonic, the verified implementation and role-grant logs resolve MINTER_ROLE to BrandedCustodian 0x54e144…, FACTORY_ROLE and the custodian owner to BrandedFactory 0x63e896…, and the ProxyAdmin owner to 0x87c7…. The token-side mint, cap, role-admin, and upgrade surfaces are therefore structured and current; the broader approved-collateral roster used by external Frax frxUSD routes remains a separate unresolved governance surface.
review.sourceFreeRationale: The current token-side on-chain minter, mint-cap owner, role administrator, and proxy upgrade controller are resolved from verified contract source and RPC reads. The approved-collateral roster for external Frax frxUSD routes is outside the USSD token contract and was not exhaustively resolved.
